_about: César Malan (1787-1864), Genevan Réveil preacher and hymn-writer: The Baptized Family, or an inquiry into the condition of children in the Christian church, translated by R. J. Bryce (Belfast: Phillips, 1860), and the Life, Labours and Writings of Caesar Malan, by one of his sons (London: Nisbet, 1869). The Life quotes his writings at length but is his son's book.
